checks.name: forge_training_settlement_binding
checks.definition:
CHECK (((settlement IS NULL) OR (((jsonb_typeof(settlement) = 'object'::text) AND ((settlement ->> 'schema'::text) = 'GOGH_TRAINING_SETTLEMENT_V1'::text) AND ((settlement ->> 'policy'::text) = 'RPC_FINALIZED_QUORUM_V1'::text) AND ((settlement ->> 'status'::text) = status) AND ((settlement ->> 'reviewHash'::text) = review_hash) AND (NOT ((settlement ->> 'transactionHash'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM transaction_hash)) AND ((settlement ->> 'finalizedBlockNumber'::text) ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$'::text) AND ((settlement ->> 'finalizedBlockHash'::text) ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND ((settlement ->> 'finalizedTimestamp'::text) ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$'::text) AND ((settlement ->> 'ownerNonce'::text) ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$'::text) AND
CASE
    WHEN (status = 'REVIEW_EXPIRED'::text) THEN (((settlement ->> 'ownerNonce'::text))::numeric <= owner_nonce)
    ELSE (((settlement ->> 'ownerNonce'::text))::numeric > owner_nonce)
END AND (((settlement ->> 'ownerNonce'::text))::numeric < power((2)::numeric, (64)::numeric)) AND ((settlement -> 'sources'::text) = '["PUBLICNODE", "ROBINHOOD"]'::jsonb) AND ((settlement ->> 'evidenceHash'::text) ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND
CASE
    WHEN (status = ANY (ARRAY['NONCE_CONSUMED'::text, 'REVIEW_EXPIRED'::text])) THEN ((((settlement ->> 'finalizedTimestamp'::text))::numeric > EXTRACT(epoch FROM expires_at)) AND (((settlement ->> 'finalizedBlockNumber'::text))::numeric >= (((review_json)::jsonb #>> '{anchor,number}'::text[]))::numeric) AND ((settlement -> 'receiptBlockNumber'::text) = 'null'::jsonb) AND ((settlement -> 'receiptBlockHash'::text) = 'null'::jsonb))
    ELSE (((settlement ->> 'receiptBlockNumber'::text) ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$'::text) AND ((settlement ->> 'receiptBlockHash'::text) ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (((settlement ->> 'receiptBlockNumber'::text))::numeric >= (((review_json)::jsonb #>> '{anchor,number}'::text[]))::numeric) AND (((settlement ->> 'receiptBlockNumber'::text))::numeric <= ((settlement ->> 'finalizedBlockNumber'::text))::numeric))
END) IS TRUE)))
